item.title: EplayerX 1.2.29
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 新增“显示资源原始路径”设置，方便在资源选择列表中辨认文件。 - 字幕搜索结果会随各来源返回逐步显示，减少等待；优化字幕服务的配置与测试反馈。 - 改善 AI 字幕与内嵌、在线及网盘字幕之间的切换，减少字幕选择被自动恢复覆盖的情况。 - 优化继续观看的进度同步、账号切换和条目移除后的刷新，减少旧状态重新出现。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Added a Show Original Resource Path setting to help identify files in the resource picker. - Subtitle search results now appear as each source responds, reducing the wait. Improved subtitle service configuration and test feedback. - Improved switching between AI, embedded, online, and cloud subtitles, reducing cases where automatic restoration overrides your selection. - Improved Continue Watching progress synchronization, account switching, and refreshes after removing items, reducing the reappearance of stale states.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
